mentions.name: Tal Katora garden
mentions.passage:
329 . (a) Tal Katora garden.
(b) Some 3 miles out of Shahjahanabad, due south-west of the Jami Masjid.
(c) Government.
(d) 11a.
(e) Late Mughal.

mentions.name: solitary tower
mentions.passage:
At a distance of some 4.5 yards from the N.-E. corner of the Tal Katora
garden there stands a solitary tower, but apparently it had no connection with
this garden.

spatialClue.anchorName: N.-E. corner of the Tal Katora garden
